title: The status of an executor's run
description: What a run of claude -p returns to spec's orchestrator as its structured output, by the contract tools/orchestrator/executor.md (R156): whether the task is done, waits on the author or failed, the questions it waits on, the pull request and the report.

status.description: done: the task is carried to an open pull request with green local checks, or needs none; waiting: it cannot go on until the author answers the questions; failed: it cannot go on, and failure says why.

report.description: The report to the author, in Russian, by the RUN.md of the repository: what was done, which files, how it was checked, what the review found, what is open.

plan.description: The plan the task was done by, when it was planned, as the pull request's description gives it; an empty string when it was not.

pull_request.description: The address of the pull request the run opened or updated, or null when there is none.

questions.description: The questions to the author the run waits on, each a row the run wrote into table 3 of its repository; empty unless status is waiting.

row.description: The row of table 3 that holds the question, by its number or its first words.

question.description: The question, in Russian, with what the author needs to decide it.

options.description: Two to four options, the recommended one first.

label.description: The option in a few words.

description.description: What the option means and what it costs.

recommendation.description: The label of the recommended option, and why, in one sentence.

failure.description: Why the task cannot go on, when status is failed; null otherwise.
